question: Can a PDF-source applicant choose an exact subset of approved facts for a standard resume without changing source facts or reusing a different draft?
inputs: Existing approved synthetic PDF service plus two 48-Claim English/Chinese synthetic formatting fixtures
checks: Exact selected wording and source IDs; omitted facts remain in the approved registry
Distinct selections produce distinct draft bindings; equivalent selections reuse a draft
Empty, repeated, unknown or malformed IDs reject without private writes
Changing the selection clears the old visible preview, PDF and adoption confirmation
Fresh profile/evidence/approval checks remain required at generation, file access and adoption
Actual native local DOCX/PDF rendering preserves selected wording and counts every output page
boundaries: Selection is a formatting choice, not fact approval or an AI recommendation
No automatic summarization, fact deletion, translation or page-count guarantee
Synthetic seeded approvals do not establish material extraction accuracy or novice completion
Keep the >=95 percent full-material recall target and all external release gates unchanged
